bio.short: Ph.D. Student, The University of Tokyo
bio.long: I am a Ph.D. student at the Department of Computer Science, The University of Tokyo, advised by Prof. Shinya Takamaeda-Yamazaki. I am also a part-time researcher at AI Computing Team, RIKEN AIP. My research interests include distributed machine learning systems, particularly federated learning under communication and computation constraints.
